title: Steve Justice at To the Stars wanted to know how saucers flew
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Steve Justice at To the Stars wanted to know how saucers flew, about late 2010s at To the Stars Academy, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Steve Justice, right? >> Yeah. >> And here was a guy who who would know where the bodies are buried, right? >> Yeah. >> And um he didn't know. He he really wanted to know how those saucers flew. >> Wow. >> That's what he told me. He says, "I want to know how they do it."

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about meeting Steve Justice at To the Stars Academy, a company set up in the late 2010s to research UFOs. Levenda says Justice was the kind of man who would know where the secrets were buried, yet told him he did not know how the saucers flew and really wanted to find out. He tells it to suggest that even well-placed insiders lack the answers.
